verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships an official MCP server and an agent-oriented CLI. The MCP server can read workspace data, work with segments and list all active automations. The CLI gives full workspace access via the App and Journeys APIs, returns structured JSON and has self-describing schemas, and the App API supports fetching data. The docs also explicitly say an AI client can 'report on how your messages perform', and the built-in agent can run broadcast recaps on a schedule. missing for 10: detailed documentation of which campaign/message performance metrics are exposed programmatically, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reporting.
